newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian PM Howard's poll lead falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian PM Howard's poll lead falls.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard's support fell to its lowest level since his election a year ago in a poll published on on Tuesday, but it remained well ahead of rival Kim Beazley and the government maintained its strong lead over Beazley's Labor opposition.

Howard, beset by a series of rows over ministerial conduct this month, saw his rating as preferred prime minister drop to 49 percent from 53 percent two weeks ago, while Beazley's rating increased one point to 24 percent.
But 27 percent of those surveyed remain uncommitted, according to the Newspoll in The Australian newspaper.
Primary support for Howard's Liberal-National government remained steady at 45 percent, while Labor's dropped to 38 percent from 40 percent in the last Newspoll two weeks ago.
The latest results compares with the coalition's primary vote of 47.3 percent and Labor's 38.8 percent in the March, 1996, election that saw Howard sweep to power, ending 13 years of Labor rule.
The poll surveyed 1,154 voters around the nation by telephone over the last weekend.
